messages:
mira: Reposting postmortem follow-ups for the GPU capacity incident. Main asks: quota bump request, scheduler tuning, headroom guard. Posting proposed owners/tl; see below.
jon: Can you paste the quota numbers we need? current vs target?
mira: Current quota per-pool = 40 GPUs, peak demand hit 62, want target 80 with burst policy. Raised RFC: https://redwood.internal/rfc/gpu-quota-bump
lee: For scheduler tuning I have a small PR that changes preemption window and pod packing. It reduced fragmentation in staging. PR: https://git/redwood/infra/PR-542
anita: Timeline? We need to commit before next sprint end (2w). Who's taking ownership of rollout verification?
mira: I'll own rollout verification for first pass. Owner table:
```
- quota: jon (request to cloud ops)
- scheduler tuning: lee (PR + canary)
- headroom planning: anita (capacity plan)
- recurring audits: mira (weekly rota)
```
mira: Canary plan: 1) apply scheduler tuning to pool-g1-canary (4 GPUs) 2) monitor 24h 3) expand to pool-g1-prod
jon: I can file quota ticket today and ping cloud-svc. ETA EOD.
lee: I'll spin up canary tomorrow morning, posting logs if any flakiness.
ops-bot: deploy status: canary deploy started by lee at 1825347920 :rocket:
anita: Let's add a KPI check: 95th latency for short seq < 120ms and eviction rate <1%
mira: noted. I'll add checks to the alerting dashboard and create a one-page runbook.
jon: Do we need a temporary headroom flag to prevent autoscaler from filling to 100%? Could set min_free_gpus=10
lee: Yes, autoscaler config patch ready, will open PR after canary is green.
mira: Great. Quick next steps: jon ticket, lee canary, mira dashboard + runbook, anita capacity doc. Weekly sync Friday 10am #incidents. :calendar:
anita: +1
jon: Ack
lee: Ack
mira: closing the loop — will update this thread with links and timestamps as actions progress.
